'''The Terran Empire''' is the 29th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on November 25, 2016. The set consists of 64 cards. This set is part of the ''Mirror Universe Block'' consisting of cards from [[Crossover (expansion)|Crossover]], [[Crossover: Supplemental]], [[Through the Looking Glass]], and [[The Terran Empire]].

==Type Breakdown==
* 5 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
* 1 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
* 9 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
* 3 Facility (3 Starfleet)
* 3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
* 7 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
* 4 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
* 25 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (3 Non-Aligned, 22 Starfleet, and 4 Vulcan)
* 4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Federation and 3 Starfleet)
* 1 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]
* 2 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
